idea-plugin.name: Optimus Accessibility
idea-plugin.description:
Optimus Accessibility is a real-time web accessibility (a11y) inspection tool for JetBrains IDEs. It works with React, Angular, and Vue, as well as vanilla HTML/JS/TS — performing a single-pass PSI tree traversal to check your HTML, JS, JSX, TS, TSX, and Vue files — including injected template strings — against WCAG/ARIA accessibility rules as you type, with one-click quick fixes.

📌 v1.0 Release: This is the 1.0 release of Optimus Accessibility. The real-time accessibility linter described here is just one aspect of the plugin — it is the first part of a larger roadmap — see below.

✨ Core Features

  • Real-Time Inspection: one optimized traversal delegates each element to every active rule — no per-rule inspection overhead.
  • 27 Accessibility Rules: across General, Anchor, ARIA, and Role categories, covering WCAG & ARIA standards.
  • Quick Fixes: add/remove attributes, remove elements, or rename tags to resolve violations instantly.
  • Framework-Aware: full inspection support for React (JSX/TSX), Angular, and Vue, as well as vanilla HTML/JS/TS — distinguishing native HTML from framework components so rules aren't misapplied to custom elements.
  • Flexible Configuration: enable/disable rules individually in Settings > Editor > Optimus Accessibility, grouped by category; export your configuration to a shareable optimus-accessibility.json; or point the plugin at a project-level JSON config file to drive rule state directly (JSON mode takes priority over manual settings).

🚀 Rule Categories

  • General & Images: Image alt text checks, form label association, heading contents, iframe titles, autofocus/accesskey rules.
  • Anchors & Links: Link validity, ambiguous text detection, and content checks.
  • ARIA Attributes: ARIA attribute validation, active descendant checks, aria-hidden focus safety.
  • Roles & Elements: Semantic tag preference over roles, role-attribute constraints, element-to-role compatibility.

🔮 What's Next

Optimus Accessibility is the first phase of a larger project. Planned for future releases:

  • Deep Project-Level Analysis: Advanced cross-file a11y auditing and compliance summaries.
  • AI-Powered Suggestions: Intelligent AI assistance for auto-generating alt text, aria labels, and structural accessibility repairs.
  • Framework-Specific Rule Sets: Today's rules are framework-aware but generic (the same 27 checks run everywhere); future rules will target patterns specific to React, Vue, Angular, and common UI design systems.
  • Expanded WCAG Coverage: Additional rules to cover more WCAG success criteria beyond the current 27.
